terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: To continue using our service, please take a moment to read and accept our terms of use.

purpose.title: 1. Purpose of the service
purpose.body: This web service is an artificial intelligence-based tool developed exclusively for scientific, educational, and research purposes. It is not a registered medical device, does not have the status of a clinical diagnostic tool, and is not intended for diagnosis, patient monitoring, or clinical decision-making.

audience.title: 2. Intended audience
audience.body: The service is intended only for qualified specialists in ultrasound diagnostics, perinatology, and related medical disciplines who have the appropriate education and experience. Access to and use of the service by persons without medical education is prohibited.

liability.title: 3. Limitation of liability
liability.efforts: The service authors make every reasonable effort to ensure the accuracy and relevance of the analysis algorithms. However, AI results may be limited by the quality of the input data, image characteristics, and current technological capabilities.
liability.results: The analysis results provided by the service are not a medical opinion, diagnosis, or recommendation.
liability.consultation: No information from the service should be used as a substitute for consultation with a treating physician or another qualified healthcare professional.

data.title: 4. Data processing
data.deidentify: • Uploading images containing patients' personal data (full name, date of birth, study numbers, and so on) is prohibited.
data.feedback: • Only images and data for which the user voluntarily provided feedback are retained in order to further improve the quality of the AI model.
data.logging: • All user actions in the system are logged for security, audit, and technical support purposes.
data.disclosure: • No data are transferred to third parties without the user's consent, except where required by law.

consent.title: 5. User consent
consent.intro: By using this service, you confirm that you:
consent.specialist: • Are a medical professional authorized to work with medical data;
consent.decisions: • Do not use the service to make clinical decisions;
consent.data: • Agree to the data processing terms stated above.

terms.important: ❗ Important: The service result is a preliminary assessment that requires interpretation and confirmation by a qualified physician. The treating specialist is responsible for the final conclusion.
terms.accept: I’ve read and agree to the terms and conditions above

access.forbiddenBody: This section is available to administrators only.

analysis.title: Image analysis
analysis.intro: Add one to ten de-identified ultrasound frames.
analysis.dropHint: JPEG or PNG, up to ten frames
analysis.guidanceSagittal: A sagittal frame of the fetal spine
analysis.guidanceAxial: An axial frame of the fetal head
analysis.deidentifyWarning: Do not upload frames containing names or other patient identifiers.
analysis.errorRemediation: Check the file and try again; frames already added are preserved.
analysis.duplicateRemediation: This frame is already in the list. Choose another file or remove the existing frame; you do not need to upload the whole batch again.
analysis.processingHint: Keep this page open until processing is complete.

layers.label: Image layer
layers.roiUnavailable: The region-of-interest image is unavailable for this frame.
layers.heatmapUnavailable: The heatmap is unavailable for this frame.

result.probabilityNote: This is not the probability of a diagnosis.

register.title: Register
register.intro: Verify your email, then wait for administrator approval. You cannot sign in before approval.

forgot-password.success: If an active account exists, a password reset link has been sent to its email address.

verify-email.title: Verify email
verify-email.intro: Press the button to verify the address from the email.
verify-email.success: Email verified. Your request is awaiting moderation. You will receive an email when approved and can then sign in.

reset-password.intro: Choose a new password. The link expires in 30 minutes and can be used once.

change-password.intro: Enter your current and new passwords. All devices will require a new sign-in.
